output.brief:
Gareth, the fall in first-contact resolution came from a Finance control change, not the April starters.

On 14 April Finance cut the credit an agent can give during a call from £100 to £25, after an audit found unsupported credits. The billing system now blocks larger amounts and refers them to Billing Resolution. The share of billing calls referred jumped from 7% to 54% that week, equally for new and experienced agents. Referred calls resolve first time only a third of the time; other billing calls still resolve at 82%. That explains the fall.

Tenured agents fell about eight points; starters sit only one point below them. The IVR change came after the fall, tariff enquiries resolve well, and workload shows no effect. I'm about 90% sure; the complaints link is weaker.

Drop the performance plans; there's no case for extending nesting or pausing IVR work. Don't restore the old limit for everyone at once. Agree with Finance a six-week, two-team trial of a higher limit with post-call sampling, tracking resolution and unsupported credits (Finance wants under 1% of value). Ask MI for one-off breakdowns, not a three-month dashboard rebuild.
